notes: These thresholds are experimental filters, not evidence of profitability.
Market cap must be calculated consistently from circulating supply and price.
Liquidity means real bonding-curve SOL reserves, never virtual reserves.
Volume and unique buyers must be deduplicated by finalized transaction signature and wallet.
A Jupiter or other router is not itself proof of a non-Pump.fun launch; inspect the underlying program and bonding-curve accounts.
This file is a documented baseline only; the current repository collector does not execute this strategy.
Examples: below $5 realized equity = 1 open position; $5 to below $10 = 2; $10 to below $15 = 3.
The $5 milestones follow the user's explicit $5/$10 examples; they are not a claim that each account doubling is exactly $5.
Do not count unrealized mark-to-market gains when increasing position capacity.
An open position occupies a slot until its exit is confirmed and reconciled.
A mint is permanently blocked from another entry after its first entry, including after a full exit.
Persist the set of previously traded mints in the durable trade ledger and reserve entry atomically before submitting an order.
